item.description:
Breathe with the moon.

New

  • The moon as a second breathing motif: breathe in towards full, out back to a crescent
  • Choose it in Settings under “Breathing” — the circle stays the default

Improved

  • The day starts with the breathing exercise again, whichever one came last
  • Icons and clearer grouping in Settings, and no more icons inside the exercise text
  • The menu shows the version and date of the build you are running

Fixed

  • The resize cursor stuck between the menu bar and the window
  • Tones could make the animation stutter; the two now run independently
